description: This file defines an interface 'ConnectivityCommand' which extends a base 'Command' interface. It specifies constants and methods related to connectivity commands, including retrieving connection identifiers and resource metadata. It also contains an inner class 'JsonFields' for JSON representation details of such commands.

classes.name: ConnectivityCommand
classes.description: A parameterized interface for all connectivity-related commands in the system, providing methods to access connection identifiers, resource paths, and command type metadata.

classes.name: ConnectivityCommand.JsonFields
classes.description: A nested class that holds JSON field definitions specific to 'ConnectivityCommand' instances, notably the 'connectionId' field.

methods.name: getConnectionId
methods.description: Returns the connection identifier as a string. Deprecated; suggests using 'getConnectionEntityId' instead.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the 'ConnectionId' object representing the connection's unique identifier.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Overrides parent method to return the connection entity ID.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Provides the resource path, defaulting to an empty JSON pointer.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string for connectivity.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Provides the prefix for the command's type string.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets Ditto headers for the command, returning the modified command instance.
